problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 31 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 39 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 31 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 65 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 48 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 60 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 47 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Omega: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Ares: size 34 cubic meters
* Shipment Hermes: size 32 cubic meters
* Shipment Apollo: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Artemis: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Athena: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Hades: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Poseidon: size 49 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeus: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Demeter: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Hera: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Hephaestus: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Dionysus: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Aphrodite: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Ares: size 65 cubic meters
* Shipment Hermes: size 43 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of total shipment volume. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
